Status

Project enquiries

The current preview form prepares a text file in your browser. It does not send your details to Montshire Media. If live enquiry handling is configured later, submitted fields will be sent to the configured email provider to respond to your enquiry. Your choices

The site stores your theme and cookie preference in your browser. You can clear this data using browser settings. No measurement IDs are configured in this preview. If enabled later, analytics scripts load only after you opt in. Advertising storage remains denied.

Before live collection

Document the purpose and lawful handling of each data field, safeguards, access and correction process, retention, cross-border processing, breach procedures and complaint contact. Review these practices against applicable Canadian privacy requirements, including PIPEDA where applicable.

Marketing consent

Future newsletter enrolment must be separate and optional, with accurate sender identification, a valid contact address and a working unsubscribe process. No subscription is created in this preview.
